patch_description: This crossover keeps the stronger shared two-hop reward from the best-performing inspiration program, while retaining the current program’s concave direct-demand signal so moderate demands still influence link selection. Two-hop rewards are divided across four potential routes and discounted at high-activity transit nodes to limit overcounting and congestion. Demand is clipped to nonnegative values, the diagonal is excluded, and the quadratic-term count stays within the stated limit. The evaluator continues to supply degree penalties.
